description.value: Red Tree Lodge is a 43-room hotel in Fernie, BC, situated on Highway 3 near downtown and a short drive from Fernie Alpine Resort in the Canadian Rockies. The lodge explicitly caters to cyclists with a dedicated bike amenities program, bike storage, and tuning tools alongside a heated boot room, indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, and fully equipped guest kitchen. Staff are described as outdoor enthusiasts with strong local knowledge of activities in the area.
